openwrt_git.Titel: ath79: add support for Sophos AP100/AP55 family
Gemeinsam: Qualcomm QCA9558 SoC @ 720 MHz (MIPS 74Kc Big-endian processor)
Green and Red status LEDs sharing a single external light-pipe
Alternate power supply via 5.5x2.1mm DC jack @ 12 VDC
Nur AP100 und AP55: USB 2.0 Type A port, power controlled via GPIO 11
openwrt_git.Hinweis 3x3: The AP100 and AP100C are hardware-identical to the AP55 and AP55C, however the 55 models' ART does not contain calibration data for their third chain despite it being present on the PCB.
openwrt_git.Flashen XG: Sophos SG/XG-Appliance, AP freigeben, awetool -> SSH auf AP, Image nach /tmp/openwrt.bin, mtd -r write /tmp/openwrt.bin astaro_image
openwrt_git.Flashen U-Boot: TFTP-Server 192.168.99.8/24, Datei uImage_AP100C, 4-pin 3.3V UART header, 115200 8/N/1, tftpboot; cp.b $fileaddr 0x9f070000 $filesize; boot
openwrt_git.Fussnote 1: Button is present but does not alter state of any GPIO on SoC
openwrt_git.Fussnote 2: Buzzer and driver circuitry is present on PCB but is not connected to any GPIO. Shorting an unpopulated resistor next to the driver circuitry should connect the buzzer to GPIO 4, but this is unconfirmed.
openwrt_git.Fussnote 4: On AP100/AP55 models the UART header is accessible after removing the device's top cover. On AP100C/AP55C models, the PCB must be removed for access; three screws secure it to the case. Pin 1 is marked on the silkscreen. Pins from 1-4 are 3.3V, GND, TX, RX
openwrt_git.Getestet: Increments confirmed across three AP55C, two AP55, and one AP100C; master und 21.02.0

openwrt_dts.Kommentar dtsi: The hardware of this board family is most likely shared with other devices from other manufacturers. Edimax appear to be the actual OEM. Sophos use the same exact board for the AP55C/AP100C, and AP55/AP100. Yes, this means your AP55C is a 3x3 AP with a software lock. AP55 and AP55C boards have different physical layouts, but are logically almost identical.
